crossRefs.note: lest I be full, deny you, and say, ‘Who is Yahweh?’ or lest I be poor, and steal, and so dishonor the name of my God.
“For my people are foolish. They don’t know me. They are foolish children, and they have no understanding. They are…
This wisdom is not that which comes down from above, but is earthly, sensual, and demonic.

translations.web: I know what I will do, so that when I am removed from management, they may receive me into their houses.’
translations.bsb: I know what I will do so that after my removal from management, people will welcome me into their homes.’
translations.kjv: I am resolved what to do, that, when I am put out of the stewardship, they may receive me into their houses.
